"why don't you believe
in God anymore?"
I was 4 years old when
a man who called himself
"a man of God"
SA'd me and a few days
later gave a speech
about lustrous desire.
I prayed and begged on
my knees in the bathroom
floor crying for hundreds
of nights.
yet he never answered.
he didn't protect me.
if there truly was an all-loving
father who cared for me as a
dear child
why didn't he protect me?
why didn't he help me?
was it "God's plan"?
was it MY fault?
that is why I am a
nonbeliever now
